title: MDS Legendary 2027 — official event page (41st edition)
claims: The 41st MDS Legendary is scheduled for 2 to 12 April 2027 in the Moroccan Sahara.
The 2027 format covers about 250 km over 6 stages in 11 days, including 9 days in the desert, in food self-sufficiency.

The 2027 programme runs stage 1 on 4 April, stage 2 on 5 April, stage 3 on 6 April, stage 4 on 7 and 8 April, stage 5 on 9 April and stage 6 on 10 April; the second day of stage 4, 8 April, is also labelled 'Repos'.

The exact 2027 route and stage distances are revealed in the roadbook handed out in Morocco two days before the start; the stage distances shown on the page are explicitly an example from the 2025 edition (32, 40, 32.5, 80–90, 42 and 21.1 km).
The page states that time cut-offs are set at 3.5 km/h.
The 2027 edition is fully booked and the page promotes an expression-of-interest form for 2028, so the 2026 edition is no longer the current edition.
The official page gives historical averages of over 30% walkers, a 90% finish rate and a 5.2 km/h average pace.
